hashkey: CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS.Change parent transformation of DM transformation
name: Change parent transformation of DM transformation
description: Change parent transformation of datamart transformation
statement:
/*
Change parent transformation of datamart transformation
*/

DECLARE 
	@StarTransformationID int = :1, --TransformationID of the star transformation which should be remapped
	@NewTransformationID int = :2, --TransformationID of the new dwh transformation
	@OldTransformationID int,
	@MissingCols nvarchar(4000) = '',
	@Transformation_Name sysname

SELECT
	@OldTransformationID = TransformationID,
	@Transformation_Name = Star_Transformation_Name
FROM
	CFG.TRANSFORMATION_STARS
WHERE
	Star_TransformationID = @StarTransformationID

IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Cannot redefine main transformation. Datamart transformation with ID  [%i] is not found', 16, 1,  @StarTransformationID)
END ELSE IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CFG.TRANSFORMATION_STARS WHERE TransformationID = @NewTransformationID AND Star_Transformation_Name = @Transformation_Name)
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Cannot redefine main transformation. The new transformation already contains the star transformation [%s]', 16, 1, @Transformation_Name)
END ELSE IF @OldTransformationID = @NewTransformationID
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Cannot redefine main transformation. The old and the new transformations are the same', 16, 1)
END ELSE BEGIN
	SELECT
		@MissingCols = @MissingCols + CASE WHEN @MissingCols = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + CS.Column_Name 
	FROM
		CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS TS 
		INNER JOIN CFG.MEASURES M ON
			M.TableID = TS.TableID
		INNER JOIN CFG.COLUMNS CS ON
			CS.ColumnID = M.ColumnID
		LEFT JOIN CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS T ON
			T.TransformationID = @NewTransformationID
		LEFT JOIN CFG.COLUMNS C ON
			C.TableID = T.TableID AND
			C.Column_Name = CS.Column_Name
	WHERE
		TS.TransformationID = @StarTransformationID AND
		C.ColumnID IS NULL

	IF @MissingCols != ''
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Cannot redefine main transformation. Following columns used in measures are missing: %s', 16, 1, @MissingCols)
	END ELSE BEGIN

		UPDATE
			CFG.TRANSFORMATION_STARS
		SET
			TransformationID = @NewTransformationID
		WHERE
			Star_TransformationID = @StarTransformationID

		EXEC CFG.CREATE_TRANS_VIEW @NewTransformationID, NULL, 1
		EXEC CFG.CREATE_TRANS_VIEW @OldTransformationID, NULL, 1
	END
END
